# Builders FirstSource

> > Builders FirstSource (BFS) is the largest supplier of building materials, manufactured components, and construction services to professional homebuilders and contractors across the United States.

The company provides comprehensive solutions including lumber, trusses, doors, windows, engineered wood products, and digital tools for construction management. With locations across states like Texas, Tennessee, Montana, Alabama, Florida, and beyond, BFS serves the residential construction industry through its First Team culture and extensive product portfolio.

## Key Topics

- Building materials and lumber supply
- Roof and floor trusses (TPI/SBCA certified)
- Exterior and interior doors
- Windows and millwork
- Engineered wood products (EWP)
- Professional installation services
- Digital construction solutions
- First Team culture and employee recognition
- Homebuilding and residential construction
- Housing market trends and affordability
- Construction project management
- State-specific locations (Texas, Tennessee, Montana, Alabama, Florida, etc.)
- Leadership and company culture
- Career opportunities in construction
- Sustainable building practices
